meta.spec: pre-specified: logistic model, leakage free prestige baseline, top decile within release quarter label

headline.interpretation: Pre-specified headline (logistic, P_tierB leakage-free baseline, within-quarter top-decile label): adding cumulative HF attention raises test AUC from 0.723 to 0.816 (dAUC +0.093, month-clustered 95% CI [+0.072, +0.109]); PR-AUC 0.255 -> 0.368; precision@top-decile 0.280 -> 0.389. log_upvotes alone gives AUC 0.800; controls add +0.016 AUC on top of upvotes (CI [+0.009, +0.025]). HGB: dAUC +0.078 [+0.050, +0.101]. Predictive, not causal; upvotes are cumulative at collection.
headline.audit_verdict: PASS/DISCLOSED — no outcome leakage in headline rows

forward_yq.description: Forward-in-time (train<=2024, test 2025), within-quarter top-decile label; 3 prestige branches x 4 feature rows; mature K=12 evaluation uses the same fitted models on test rows with age_months>=12 and labels re-ranked within quarter on that subset.
forward_yq.label: y_q

forward_ym.description: Robustness: label = top decile of citation_count within release MONTH.
forward_ym.label: y_m

forward_yinf.description: Robustness: label = top decile of INFLUENTIAL citations within release quarter.
forward_yinf.label: y_inf

backward_yq.description: Backward test: train on 2024-2025, test on 2023 (mature cohort, 29-40 months exposure); within-quarter label.
backward_yq.label: y_q

drop_age.description: Robustness: age_months removed from controls (train and test age ranges do not overlap).
drop_age.label: y_q

legacy_subfield.description: FLAGGED robustness: legacy `subfield` (two taxonomies keyed on upvote-ordered arXiv fetch) instead of subfield_kw — shows the attention proxy that leaked into the v1 controls-only baseline.
legacy_subfield.label: y_q

v2_leaky_replication.description: FLAGGED context row: today-measured max_hindex added to the P_interim baseline (v2-style leak).
v2_leaky_replication.label: y_q

split_temporal.detail: train=release_year<=2024 (n=5,019), test=release_year=2025 (n=6,325); years and quarters disjoint (asserted).

labels_same_snapshot_caveat.detail: All citation counts are one 2026-06 snapshot; train labels use longer exposure windows than test labels. Within-cohort ranking, the K=12 mature row and the backward-2023 test address this; a true forward simulation would need historical snapshots.

scalers_fit_on_train_only.detail: SimpleImputer/StandardScaler/OneHotEncoder inside a Pipeline fitted on train only; test transformed with frozen objects.

hyperparameters_tuned_on_train_only.detail: GridSearchCV with GroupKFold(5) grouped by release_month on train; one evaluation on test.

headline_model_prespecified.detail: headline model=logistic, branch=P_tierB, row=+attention, CI=month_cluster; no test-set-based selection of model or branch.

target_is_label_only.detail: citation_count/influential_citations used only to build labels; FORBIDDEN set asserted for every feature matrix.

within_group_ranks.detail: upvote_rank_within_month and all labels are within-group ranks; release_month/quarter never enter as features.

forbidden_columns_absent.detail: check_features() raised on any forbidden column; max_hindex only in v2_leaky_replication, legacy `subfield` only in legacy_subfield.

tierB_columns_whitelisted.detail: P_tierB uses exactly log1p_max_prior_papers_true + max_years_active; tierB_resolved, *_first_year and raw/winsorised counts excluded; missing Tier-B values: train 82, test 16 (median-imputed).

label_provenance_uniform.detail: subfield_kw comes from one rule set for every paper; source flag (ai_keywords vs fallback) predicts the label with AUC 0.518 in test. The legacy `subfield` provenance flag (arXiv fetched) had AUC 0.659 — that leak is now confined to the flagged legacy_subfield row.

subfield_kw.taxonomy: single ordered keyword rule set (v2 KEYWORD_RULES) applied to HF ai_keywords, fallback title+summary, else Other — identical rules for every paper

legacy_subfield.taxonomy: MIXED: arXiv-category map for papers whose arXiv metadata was fetched (high-upvote-first fetch, ~27% of papers) and keyword rules for the rest

attention_is_cumulative_at_collection.detail: upvotes are the cumulative HF count at collection (June 2026), not a day-one measurement; n_trend_days is 1 for essentially all papers so 'peak' == snapshot. Evidence that late accrual is small relative to cross-paper variation: flat monthly medians after the launch era and near-zero Spearman(upvotes, age_months) within 2024 and 2025.

age_months_support.detail: age_months is a deterministic function of release date and does not overlap across the split; the drop_age robustness row shows the sensitivity.

age_months.note: planned exposure to snapshot; deterministic in release date (see age_months_support)

has_github.note: GitHub link on HF page at scrape time; may be added later

subfield_kw.note: keyword rules on HF ai_keywords/title/summary; uniform taxonomy for all papers

log1p_max_prior_papers_true / max_years_.note: Tier B: papers strictly before anchor date; leakage-free

log_upvotes.note: cumulative upvotes at collection (2026-06); not day-one

upvote_rank_within_month.note: needs the whole month cohort; retrospective, transductive

log1p_num_comments.note: cumulative HF comments at collection; ablation only

subfield (legacy).note: label source keyed on upvote-ordered fetch; legacy_subfield row only

prestige_branch_tags.P_tierB: DEFINITIVE — leakage-free prior-paper count (log1p, strictly before anchor date) + years active

bootstrap.note: paired over test rows (or test release-months), conditional on the trained models; ignores training-set variability and model selection.
